image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a wombat standing in snow. The animal has dark brown to black coarse fur, a broad blunt head, small rounded ears, and a large bare nose. Its front paws are visible, appearing dark and sturdy, resting on the white snowy surface. The background is out-of-focus white snow.
